import pathlib
base=pathlib.Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out-4/play/users/u064/system/state/workspace')
(base/'programs').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
script='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The left panels are separated by full-width rows of the frame color.
    frame = grid[0][0]
    left_w = 0
    while left_w < w and grid[0][left_w] == frame:
        left_w += 1
    dividers = [r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == frame for c in range(left_w))]
    out = [row[:left_w] for row in grid]

    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row[left_w:] if v != 0}
    shapes = {}
    for color in colors:
        pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(left_w, w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if not pts:
            continue
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
        shapes[color] = tuple(tuple(int((r, c) in pts) for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)) for r in range(r0, r1 + 1))

    for top, bottom in zip(dividers, dividers[1:]):
        pattern = tuple(tuple(int(grid[r][c] == 0) for c in range(1, left_w - 1)) for r in range(top + 1, bottom))
        color = next((col for col, shape in shapes.items() if shape == pattern), None)
        if color is not None:
            for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
                for c in range(1, left_w - 1):
                    if grid[r][c] == 0:
                        out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
